component.name: Sukhi Play
component.summary: Let a small child open only the sites you choose

description.p: Sukhi Play turns a computer into a safe place for a small child to play. They get a few big buttons, one per site a parent has allowed, and nothing else.

Everything else is switched off: other websites, advertising, popups, new windows, downloads, and the keyboard shortcuts that would otherwise let a three-year-old wander into your work. Leaving needs a grown-up.
It ships with nothing enabled. A parent chooses what is allowed:

ul.li: Each site gets an allowlist, and anything not essential to it is cut
Advertising and trackers are blocked on top of that
No popups, no new windows, no downloads, no navigating away
Arrow keys and WASD still reach the page, so games still work
Closing the app needs a three-second press and hold

description.p: This is not a substitute for adult supervision. It reduces what a small child can reach; it does not childproof a computer.

screenshot.caption: What your child sees: only the apps you approved
First run: nothing is allowed until a grown-up chooses
Setup offers a curated list, or any address you type
The grown-up portal: every app, with a switch to hide it
Adding an app: type an address, it works out the rest
Suggestions: a curated list, each one already checked
Closing takes a steady press a small child will not manage
